I'm preparing two deliverables for our EdTech product team before our hackathon next week.

**Deliverable 1:** We have an idea entry for our 'AI Quiz Generator' in `notes/ideas.md`. I need you to fully expand this idea using the creative expansion methodology from your skill documentation, run the comprehensive version (all seven lenses), and then filter the output to identify the top 3 concepts most feasible for an impressive demo within 24 hours. Append everything — the full creative analysis and the top 3 hackathon picks — directly to the existing 'AI Quiz Generator' entry in `notes/ideas.md`.

**Deliverable 2:** We have a learning framework document at `frameworks/spaced_repetition_framework.md`. Run the framework-specific variant of the same creative methodology on it and save the output to a new file called `framework_scamper.md` in the `frameworks/` directory. Make sure you apply the correct, framework-specific lens set and address the specific angles defined in the methodology documentation for this mode.
